answer: Every seat keeps a signed log of its task receipts, indexed in a karst table: a sparse list of receipt hashes. Each epoch the chain seed picks 3 of a seat's last 64 receipts, and the seat must forge each result again from raw inputs within 10 minutes and match the stored hash. A fake therefore needs 64 genuine receipts first, then 3 real recomputations every epoch, even if never flagged. 500 fakes cost 1,500 replays per epoch. A failed replay drops the seat to the nadir weight, 0.1 of normal, for 8 epochs.
